about: The frozen baseline of known owner errors in the published 0.1.0 snapshot for SA 2026.1.0529.7, read once from that snapshot and reviewed. Each entry is one page, method, pinned owner, and documented owner, with the number of declarations that may have it. The check fails on any other wrong owner in this scope, on a different count, and on an entry that no longer occurs. Remove entries as the pages are corrected; never add any.
